helpSupport.title: Help & Support
helpSupport.subtitle: Find answers, send feedback or get in touch.
helpSupport.q1: How do I track my progress?
helpSupport.a1: Your progress is automatically saved after completing each lesson test. Visit the Profile page to see an overview.
helpSupport.q2: Can I retake a lesson test?
helpSupport.a2: Yes! You can retake any lesson test as many times as you like. Your latest score will be recorded.
helpSupport.a3: Badges are awarded automatically based on your learning milestones — completing lessons and achieving high scores.
helpSupport.q4: How do I change my language?
helpSupport.a4: Go to Settings → Language and select your preferred language. The app will switch immediately.
helpSupport.reportBugDesc: Found something broken? Let us know.

1.title: Initial Communication Ability Assessment Questionnaire
1.description:
Below are twelve situations in which you might need to communicate. People's skills to communicate effectively vary greatly, and sometimes the same person can communicate more competently in one situation than in another.

Please indicate how competent you consider yourself to be in communication for each of the situations described below. Note in the space provided for each item your estimate of your communication competence level.

questions.101: Give a presentation in front of a group of strangers
questions.103: Talk in a large meeting with friends.
questions.104: Talk in a small group of strangers.
questions.106: Talk in a large meeting with acquaintances.
questions.108: Give a presentation in front of a group of friends
questions.109: Talk in a small group of acquaintances
questions.110: Talk in a large meeting with strangers
questions.111: Talk in a small group of friends
questions.112: Give a presentation in front of a group of acquaintances

2.title: Career Adapt-Abilities Inventory
2.description:
People use different strengths to build their careers. No one is good at everything, and each person develops certain skills more than others. Please evaluate how developed the following skills are for you, using the scale below.

5 = Very strongly developed
4 = Strongly developed
3 = Fairly developed
2 = Little developed
1 = Not at all developed

questions.201: I think about what my future will look like.
questions.202: I realize that today's choices influence my future.
questions.204: I become aware of the educational and professional choices I must make.
questions.205: I plan how I will achieve my goals.
questions.206: I am concerned about my career.
questions.208: I make decisions on my own.
questions.209: I take responsibility for my actions.
questions.210: I stick up for my beliefs.
questions.212: I do what I think is right for me.
questions.214: I look for opportunities to grow as a person.
questions.215: I investigate options before making a choice.
questions.216: I observe different ways of doing things.
questions.217: I probe deeply into questions I have.
questions.218: I become curious about new opportunities.
questions.220: I take care to do things well.
questions.222: I work up to my ability.

3.title: Emotional Intelligence Assessment
3.description:
Please evaluate how developed the following skills are for you, using the scale below.

5 = Very strongly developed
4 = Strongly developed
3 = Fairly developed
2 = Little developed
1 = Not at all developed

questions.301: I recognize very well the emotion a person is feeling at any given moment.
questions.302: Even when I am very nervous, I know what to look for to understand others' emotions.
questions.303: I can always sense changes in a person's emotional state.
questions.304: It is easy for me to describe the emotions a person is feeling.
questions.305: I always correctly anticipate a person's behavior based on the emotions they are feeling.
questions.306: I always understand how one emotion can generate another.
questions.307: I am able to correctly predict what I will do based on the emotion I am feeling.
questions.308: I describe my emotions very easily.
questions.309: I am aware of my emotions at every moment.
questions.310: I am aware of my emotions even in difficult situations.
questions.311: I quickly realize what exactly is generating my emotions.
questions.312: It is easy for me to understand the factors that influence my emotions.
questions.313: I am always able to calm someone down if needed.
questions.314: I often help others overcome difficult emotional states.
questions.315: If an acquaintance is sad, I am able to make them feel better.
questions.316: I always take my emotions into account when making a decision.
questions.317: I can simulate various emotions if needed.
questions.318: I express my emotions spontaneously to achieve the desired effect.
questions.319: I can use my emotions to achieve a goal.
questions.320: I am able to temper my emotional outbursts well.
questions.321: Usually, I overcome unpleasant emotional states on my own.
questions.322: My emotions do not prevent me from carrying out my activities.
questions.323: I always use my emotions when I communicate.
questions.324: I quickly realize the possible consequences (physiological or behavioral) of my emotions.

4.title: Teamwork Assessment
4.description:
Please evaluate how developed the following skills are for you, using the scale below.

5 = Very strongly developed
4 = Strongly developed
3 = Fairly developed
2 = Little developed
1 = Not at all developed

questions.401: I prefer to work in team tasks rather than individual tasks.
questions.402: When I have a choice, I try to work in a group instead of alone.
questions.403: I personally enjoy working with others.
questions.404: Group work is better than working alone.
questions.405: Working in a group is better than working alone.
questions.406: If I had a choice, I would rather perform a task where I can work alone than perform a task where I have to work with others in a group.
questions.407: I like to interact with others when working on projects.
